items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: You did a thing with Ornette Coleman, “Celebration?” In ’89 was it? Probably.

ctx.x: You don’t want to mess up. Nobody wanted to mess up. And the band was so good that everybody, almost everybody messed up a little just listening to the other people. But it was really an educational experience. It was really something. I still think about some of the singing I heard.
Let me take you back to a couple of things in your career. You did a thing with Ornette Coleman, “Celebration?” In ’89 was it?
